source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: hello muhammad, how much do you charge to help us refine a financial model? we already have the template and data but we need someone to help me check the data and refine...let me know if you can do it and how much you will charge for that

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hi Muhammed,

Thank you for your quick response. We are in the process of submitting a financial model to the government for a potential PPP project. A key requirement is to clearly demonstrate and justify the need for availability-style payments to ensure the project is viable and bankable.

I have attached the Excel template along with additional project details for your review. Please let me know if you are able to support us in developing this model. There might be some errors, please help us check it and make it look professional and clear and strong

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: please do a good job and make sure the modeling is flawless as it will be reviewed by the government

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: please check the model very well and feel free to make changes to help improve the model. at the end of the day i need the numbers to make sense and look credible

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: There is nothing exploitative about this, as I mentioned earlier. Your statement doesn't make sense. The work you provided is difficult to understand and of poor quality, with many errors. Rather than wasting time on back-and-forth, I chose to hire another freelancer for a fresh start. I do not wish to continue this work, and you know that the delivered work is subpar. My intention isn't to end on bad terms or leave a negative review.
